title: Spikes corrupt score: 100 jumps to 65136, then goes negative (-300)
observed: At tick 14 the player hits spikes at score 100 and the score becomes 65136 instead of 0 (100 - 500, floored at 0). Later a coin takes it to -300.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0. Score must stay within 0..999,999 and never go negative. From 100, a spike hit should give 0.

title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
observed: After pause then click btn-restart, the state reads mode 'paused' and the pause menu's buttons remain. The score, lives and timer are reset, but the game is not running.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', no pause menu).

title: HUD coins shows 0/5 after collecting a coin
observed: After collecting a coin (state coins=1), the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5' while the score HUD already shows 100.
expected: The HUD always shows current values, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: HUD time stale after resuming from pause
observed: After clicking Resume, the state shows timeLeft 299 but the HUD still reads 'Time 300'.
expected: The HUD shows the current timer value, so it should read 'Time 299' after the first running tick.

title: Restart level leaves the game paused with no dialog, so input is ignored
observed: After pause+right and click:btn-restart, the state stays mode=paused with no dialog or pause menu shown. Waiting for 25 more ticks changes nothing: timer stays 300, enemies do not move, and the player has no visible button to act on.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so the timer and enemies should advance on the next tick.

title: Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
observed: With the pause menu open, the 'Key collected' toast is on top of btn-resume, so btn-resume reports top=false and a click there would not reach it. btn-restart is not covered.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it, including toasts shown during the pause.

title: HUD coins stays at 0/5 after a dash collects a coin
observed: After dash-down passes over a coin, state.coins is 1 and the score shows 100, but the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5' and stays stale while paused.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: HUD timer lags one tick behind the game timer
observed: After click:btn-resume the state reads timeLeft=299 but the HUD still shows 'Time 300', and it remains 300 while paused on the next tick.
expected: The HUD always shows the current timer value (ticks left), so it should read 'Time 299' to match the state.

title: HUD coins not updated after a dash collects a coin
observed: After dash-down at tick 12 collects a second coin, state.coins is 2 but the HUD shows 'Coins 1/5'. The HUD stays one behind.
expected: The HUD shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 2/5' after the second coin is collected.
